goal: Ensure the IWYU CI task fails on compiler errors instead of silently passing
Prevents missed include checks when source files fail to compile
agreement: Agreed CI should fail loudly instead of silently passing (maflcko)
Nonblocking objection: removing the masking flag directly is a better fix than grepping logs (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it ensures fatal compiler errors in the IWYU CI job fail the build instead of being masked
The benefit is limited to an auxiliary static analysis task rather than main build integrity
